nodes.name: NiFe-LDH co-precipitation
nodes.procedure: 1 mmol of FeSO4·7H2O and 1 mmol of NiSO4·6H2O were dissolved in 20 mL of deionized water, followed by the dropwise addition of 0.5 mL of ammonia solution. The precipitate was washed and dried to obtain NiFe-LDH.
nodes.source_text: NiFe-LDH was prepared by co-precipitation method. 1 mmol of FeSO4·7H2O and 1 mmol of NiSO4·6H2O were dissolved in 20 mL of deionized water, followed by the dropwise addition of 0.5 mL of ammonia solution.
